eventDetail.scope: The 6th International Conference on New Paradigms in Electronics and Information Technology (PEIT 2026) aims to provide a comprehensive platform for researchers, scientists, and industry professionals to present and discuss the latest advancements, emerging trends, and innovative applications in the fields of electronics and information technology.  The conference focuses on both theoretical developments and practical implementations across a wide range of topics, including but not limited to power electronics, renewable energy systems, microelectronics, RF and microwave engineering, communication systems, signal processing, computer engineering, and information technology.  PEIT 2026 also emphasizes interdisciplinary research that integrates artificial intelligence, data science, and intelligent systems with modern electronic and communication technologies to address real-world engineering challenges.
